name: Fake CBI/Police Digital Arrest
escalation: Threatening immediate arrest over fake charges unless a 'security deposit' is transferred.
truth: Indian law enforcement agencies never conduct 'digital arrests' over Skype/WhatsApp or ask for security deposits.

name: Fake Customs / Parcel Seizure
escalation: Claiming a parcel in your name contains drugs/passports and demanding clearance fees.
truth: Customs officials do not call individuals demanding money to release seized parcels.

name: UPI Refund / Receive Money
escalation: Tricking the victim into entering their UPI PIN under the guise of receiving a refund.
truth: UPI PIN is only required to SEND money, NEVER to receive money.

name: Fake Bank KYC Update
escalation: Sending malicious links to steal internet banking credentials for 'KYC verification'.
truth: Banks never send SMS with generic links asking to update KYC or threatening immediate account blockage.

name: Loan App Harassment
escalation: Extorting money by threatening to send morphed photos to the victim's contacts.
truth: These are illegal apps. Do not pay. Report to the police immediately.

name: Fake Job Offer / Advance Fee
escalation: Offering a high-paying easy job but asking for an initial fee or investment.
truth: Legitimate employers never ask candidates to pay money or 'invest' to get a job.

name: SIM Swap / OTP Phishing
escalation: Tricking the victim into forwarding OTPs or activating call forwarding.
truth: Telecom operators do not ask you to dial *401* (call forwarding) or share OTPs for upgrades.

name: Electricity Bill Disconnection
escalation: Threatening power cut tonight and sharing a number/app to pay immediately.
truth: Electricity boards never send SMS from personal numbers threatening immediate nighttime disconnections.

name: Matrimonial / Romance Scam
escalation: Building a relationship online and then suddenly asking for money due to a fake emergency.
truth: Never send money to someone you have only met online, regardless of the story.

name: Fake Income Tax Notice
escalation: Sending phishing links claiming a tax refund is pending.
truth: The Income Tax Department only communicates via the official e-filing portal and doesn't ask for bank details via SMS links.

name: Fake Lottery / Prize Winning
escalation: Claiming the victim won a huge amount but must pay 'tax' or 'processing fee' first.
truth: You cannot win a lottery you did not enter, and you never have to pay upfront to claim real winnings.

name: Courier Customs Duty Scam
escalation: Demanding online payment to clear an unexpected international parcel.
truth: Official customs duties are collected via the postal service or official courier channels, not random WhatsApp links.
